name: Air France KLM World Elite Mastercard

localized_names.en: Air France KLM World Elite Mastercard

annual_fee.waiver_conditions: First year annual fee free! Upon your one year anniversary, the annual fee will be CAD $132.00. Each additional cardmember is $50 a year.

apr.notes: Preferred annual rates are 19.99% on purchases and balance transfers and 21.50% on cash advances. If the Total Minimum Payment is missed for any 2 billing periods within 12 months, the standard rate of 21.99% applies to all three. Cash advance fee is $3.50 in Canada or $5 outside Canada. Cardmember Agreement in effect as of March 15, 2024.

fx_fee.notes: Foreign Currency Conversion Fee is 1.5% of the converted amount, on both credits and debits, per the Cardmember Agreement.

rewards.redemption_notes: Earn Miles on everyday spend that contribute to your Flying Blue Rewards. Redeem for as low as 15,000 Miles one-way to Europe.

notes: Issued and administered by Brim Financial. Network tier is World Elite Mastercard per the card name in the Cardmember Agreement. The product page also lists up to 30 Miles per $1 at Merchant Partners, and a 60XP welcome bonus for new cardholders plus 30XP on each card anniversary renewal. XP are Flying Blue status points, not Miles, so signup_bonus is null.
